nodes.label: Independent Version Domains
nodes.rationale: Product packages use SemVer while durable contracts (API, event schema, canonicalization, SQLite schema, Alembic revision, workflow schema) version independently so a package release never silently reinterprets stored data.

nodes.label: Action Canonicalization Versioning
nodes.rationale: Any byte-level change to canonical action bytes requires a new version; old challenges retain old bytes until expiry.

nodes.label: Forward-Only Backup-First Migrations
nodes.rationale: migrate apply creates and verifies an encrypted owner-only backup before forward migration; a newer or damaged schema is refused rather than downgraded or reinterpreted.

nodes.label: Signed Release Manifest Verification
nodes.rationale: update check verifies channel, version, minimum schema, HTTPS URL, SHA-256 digest, and Ed25519 signature but never downloads or executes the artifact.
